name: Madeira Promotion Bureau (Associação de Promoção da Madeira)
note: Madeira's destination promotion association: publisher of the official tourism site visitmadeira.com (site footer: 'Copyright © 2026 Madeira Promotion Bureau') and of the 'Madeira. Tão tua' destination brand (madeirabelongstoall.com). TNews (13 Apr 2021) reported at the brand's 2021 launch that the new Madeira brand is used both by VisitMadeira and by the Regional Government of Madeira.
